metadata.title: Fish with Bamboo Shoots| Khorisa Maas | Assamese Recipe
metadata.description:
Khorisa Maas is an Assamese specialty dish which literally translates as bamboo shoot and fish. This Assamese style fish curry is quite popular in Assamese homes and is an amazing side with steamed rice. 

This traditional fish recipe can be made with either fresh bamboo shoots, or fermented bamboo shoots, Fresh or fermented both of them have a very distinct flavor.
